title: Sidero Labs｜Talos Linux 与 Omni 的缔造者
author: Hacker News
content:
Kubernetes · Talos Linux

Kubernetes infrastructure that can’t drift and won’t fail an audit.

Talos Linux is the immutable, API-driven operating system purpose-built for Kubernetes. No SSH, no shell, no package manager. Just the binaries needed to run your fleet, from bare metal to the edge.

Read the docs

Go to repo →See Talos Enterprise Linux →

Free & Enterprise

One codebase. Two ways to run it.

Talos Linux is free and open source under MPL-2.0. Talos Enterprise Linux is the same OS. What the enterprise tier adds is proof, indemnity, and someone to call: the assurance, compliance evidence, and support that security and procurement teams need to sign off.

Shared foundation

The only difference is that the Enterprise build enables FIPS 140-3 compliance, and adds the security artifacts, indemnity, CVE SLAs, and support.

Open stays open. Enterprise adds assurance and service on top of the same open-source OS. Same code, same MPL-2.0, your hardware. Security is never gated behind the paid tier.

Trusted by enterprise platform teams

In production across regulated, sovereign, and mission-critical environments.

Why Talos Linux

Infrastructure that can’t drift, and can’t be logged into.

Most fleets are held together by hand, and the gaps are where they break. Talos removes the gaps by design, the same across every cluster and every site.

Minimal

Minimal by design

Fewer than 50 binaries, just enough to run Kubernetes. Minimal attack surface, minimal CVEs.

API-only

No SSH, no shell

Every node interaction goes through a secured gRPC API with mutual TLS. Nothing to log into.

Immutable

Read-only & ephemeral

Nothing is written to disk at runtime, nothing persists between reboots. A reboot returns the node to its declared state.

Declarative

One YAML, whole machine

The entire machine state is defined declaratively. No configuration-management tools to maintain.

Atomic

Unified lifecycle

OS and Kubernetes upgrade together as one atomic, rollback-safe image. The same swap from day zero on.

Hardened

Secure by default

mTLS on all API access, CIS guidelines applied out of the box, SELinux and trusted boot included.

Talos Enterprise Linux

Clear the security review. Keep the open-source OS.

Everything Talos Linux does, plus Omni fleet management, the audit evidence, indemnity, and response times that get an open-source OS through enterprise procurement. Built for NIS2 and CRA.

Compliance

FIPS & regulatory fit

FIPS 140-3 compliant builds and a posture built for the frameworks auditors ask about.

Supply chain

Artifacts security teams demand

Evidence tied to the exact image you run, traceable back to source.

Support

24/7/365, with targets

The people who wrote the code, not a tier-1 helpdesk.

Legal

Commercial IP indemnity

The contractual protection procurement expects from a commercial vendor.

Talk to us about Enterprise →

Adopted in the open

In the community’s words

Fleet management

When ready to manage a fleet, Omni builds on talosctl

When the fleet outgrows manual lifecycle management, Omni takes over provisioning, upgrades, config, and backups across every cluster from one place. It also schedules containers directly on Talos at single-node edge sites, with no Kubernetes cluster required, managed through the same fleet plane.

aiSummary: Talos Linux 是一款专为 Kubernetes 设计的不可变、由 API 驱动的操作系统，移除了 SSH、Shell 访问和包管理器，并通过 Talos Enterprise Linux 提供 FIPS 140-3 合规性与企业级支持。
oneSentenceSummary: Talos Linux 是一款专为 Kubernetes 设计的不可变、由 API 驱动的操作系统，移除了 SSH、Shell 访问和包管理器，并通过 Talos Enterprise Linux 提供 FIPS 140-3 合规性与企业级支持。
summary: Talos Linux 是一款专为 Kubernetes 基础设施打造的不可变、由 API 驱动的操作系统。它摒弃了 SSH、Shell 访问和包管理器等传统管理方式，只提供运行 Kubernetes 集群所需的基本二进制文件，适用于从裸机到边缘环境的各种场景。该系统采用声明式设计，整台机器的状态都由 YAML 定义；系统为只读且临时性的，确保节点在重启后恢复到声明的状态。Talos Enterprise Linux 在沿用 MPL-2.0 许可下同一开源代码库的同时，增加了 FIPS 140-3 合规性、审计证据、赔偿保障和全天候支持。Omni 则提供集群群组管理能力，帮助用户摆脱手动管理生命周期的限制，实现规模化运维。该平台通过所有 API 访问均采用 mTLS、遵循 CIS 指南、使用 SELinux 和可信启动等方式强化安全性，适用于受监管、主权云及任务关键型环境。

mainPoints.point: Talos Linux 是一款不可变、由 API 驱动的操作系统，不提供 SSH、Shell 或包管理器
mainPoints.explanation: 所有节点交互都通过启用双向 TLS 的安全 gRPC API 进行，取代传统访问方式，并将攻击面缩减至少于 50 个二进制文件。

mainPoints.point: 该系统采用声明式和临时性设计，运行时为只读
mainPoints.explanation: 整台机器的状态均由 YAML 定义，运行时不会向磁盘写入内容；重启后，节点会恢复到声明的状态，从而避免基础设施发生配置漂移。

mainPoints.point: Talos Enterprise Linux 提供 FIPS 140-3 合规性与企业级支持
mainPoints.explanation: 企业版提供合规性证据、赔偿保障、CVE SLA，以及由代码作者提供的全天候支持，同时继续使用同一开源代码库。

mainPoints.point: Omni 提供群组管理能力，帮助用户摆脱手动运维的限制，实现规模化管理
mainPoints.explanation: Omni 可通过统一管理平面处理多个集群的部署、升级、配置和备份；在边缘站点，它还可以直接在 Talos 上调度容器，无需 Kubernetes。

keyQuotes: Talos Linux 是一款专为 Kubernetes 打造的不可变、由 API 驱动的操作系统。没有 SSH，没有 Shell，也没有包管理器。
让基础设施不发生配置漂移，也不会在审计中出问题。
少于 50 个二进制文件，只保留运行 Kubernetes 所需的内容。攻击面更小，CVE 也更少。
每次与节点的交互都通过启用双向 TLS 的安全 gRPC API 进行。无需登录任何系统。
整台机器的状态都以声明式方式定义。无需维护配置管理工具。
